dwl_req_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin connected to the PN7160's `DWL_REQ` line. Used to invoke the PN7160's firmware update mode; may be used in a future release.

*See also: [PN7160 NFC](https://esphome.io/components/pn7160#configuration-variables)*

emulation_message.docs:
**string**: When scanned by another NFC card/tag reader (such as a smartphone), this string is used as the content for an NDEF-formatted response. This allows the PN7160 to act as a tag in addition to a tag reader/writer.

*See also: [PN7160 NFC](https://esphome.io/components/pn7160#configuration-variables)*

irq_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin connected to the PN7160's `IRQ` line.

*See also: [PN7160 NFC](https://esphome.io/components/pn7160#configuration-variables)*

on_emulated_tag_scan.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the PN7160 is scanned by another tag reader (such as a smartphone). See [`on_emulated_tag_scan` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/pn7160#pn7160-on_emulated_tag_scan).

*See also: [PN7160 NFC](https://esphome.io/components/pn7160#configuration-variables)*

on_tag.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a tag is first read. See [`on_tag` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/pn7160#pn7160-on_tag).

*See also: [PN7160 NFC](https://esphome.io/components/pn7160#configuration-variables)*

on_tag_removed.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform after a tag is removed. See [`on_tag_removed` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/pn7160#pn7160-on_tag_removed).

*See also: [PN7160 NFC](https://esphome.io/components/pn7160#configuration-variables)*

tag_ttl.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The duration that must elapse after the PN7160 is no longer able to "see" a tag before it is considered to have been removed from the reader.

*See also: [PN7160 NFC](https://esphome.io/components/pn7160#configuration-variables)*

ven_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin connected to the PN7160's `VEN` line.

*See also: [PN7160 NFC](https://esphome.io/components/pn7160#configuration-variables)*

wkup_req_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin connected to the PN7160's `WKUP_REQ` line. May be used to improve power management in a future release.

*See also: [PN7160 NFC](https://esphome.io/components/pn7160#configuration-variables)*
